title: 多益高頻商務片語與句型 - 第 4 輯
description: 精選聽力 Part 3/4 與閱讀 Part 5/6 常考關鍵片語與搭配句型。

words.definitionZh: （尤指薪資、款項）預付；墊付

visualAnchor.imagePrompt: Senior corporate financial analyst pointing at high-resolution revenue and expenditure growth charts on glass digital dashboard, modern corporate boardroom, executive team discussing quarterly reports, photorealistic, cinematic lighting, 8k
visualAnchor.scene: 財務團隊於現代會議室審查季度財務與預算分析之商務情境

examples.scenario: 日常商務 (圖像記憶錨點)
examples.en: All project leaders are required to submit their weekly progress summaries give A an advance before Friday's executive meeting.
examples.zh: 所有專案主管均被要求在週五高層會議之前，【預付】提交每週進度摘要。

examples.en: Management confirmed that the new workplace safety policy will take effect give A an advance across all manufacturing plants.
examples.zh: 管理層確認新的工作場所安全政策將【預付】在所有製造工廠生效落實。

examples.en: Our corporation expanded its global distribution network give A an advance to satisfy rising international consumer demand.
examples.zh: 我司【預付】擴展了全球經銷網絡，以滿足日益增長的國際消費者需求。

quizzes.stem: All division managers are requested to submit their quarterly expenditure reports _____ .
quizzes.stemTranslation: 請所有部門經理務必【預付】提交季度支出報告。
quizzes.strategy: 分析句末副詞/介系詞片語位置，選入最切合商務作業規範之片語 give A an advance。
quizzes.examTrapTip: 多益常考商務固定片語搭配，切勿僅字面直翻。

optionAnalyses.reason: 【正解】詞義「預付」與文法形態完全切合題幹之商務語境。
【干擾】此選項與題幹前後文意及商務搭配不符，予以排除。
【干擾】此選項與題幹前後文意及商務搭配不符，予以排除。
【干擾】此選項與題幹前後文意及商務搭配不符，予以排除。

quizzes.stem: Strict compliance with established _____ is mandatory for all personnel operating heavy machinery.
quizzes.stemTranslation: 切實遵守既定的【預付】，對於所有操作重型機具之人員皆屬強制規定。
quizzes.strategy: established 為形容詞，介系詞 with 之後需填入受詞名詞 give A an advance。
quizzes.examTrapTip: 注意介系詞後受詞之詞性要求與上下文語法結構。
collocations: in accordance with give A an advance

optionAnalyses.reason: 【正解】文法詞性完全符合空格之結構要求。
【干擾】此詞形在此處文法結構中不符。

quizzes.stem: In the business memorandum, the word 'give A an advance' is closest in meaning to which of the following?
quizzes.stemTranslation: 在該商務備忘錄中，單字「give A an advance」（【預付】）的意思與下列何者最接近？
quizzes.strategy: 在商務語境中，give A an advance（預付）之核心涵義與 give A an advance 最相近。
quizzes.examTrapTip: 多益同義字測驗考查商務上下文語境，需選擇最具替換性之選項。
collocations: give A an advance = give A an advance

optionAnalyses.reason: 【正解】在商務語境中為最精確之同義詞替換。
【干擾】語意不符或無法替換題幹單字。

quizzes.stem:
📧 [INTERNAL MEMORANDUM]
To: All Department Staff
Subject: Important Operational Update

Please ensure that our division takes all necessary measures to _____ established corporate benchmarks across daily operations.
quizzes.stemTranslation:
📧【內部備忘錄】
收件人：全體部門同仁
主旨：重要營運更新

請確保我們部門採取一切必要措施，在日常營運中【預付】既定的企業基準。
quizzes.strategy: 內部備忘錄公告提及 takes measures to _____（採取措施以...），填入 give A an advance 最切合商務政策語境。
quizzes.examTrapTip: 內部行政備忘錄常使用正式書面語體與政策規章搭配。
collocations: adhere to give A an advance

quizzes.stem:
📩 [CLIENT CORRESPONDENCE]
To: Global Procurement Partners
Subject: Partnership and Service Confirmation

We are delighted to confirm that our organization can _____ your upcoming business requirements on schedule.
quizzes.stemTranslation:
📩【客戶商務信函】
收件人：全球採購合作夥伴
主旨：合作關係與服務確認

我們很高興地向您確認，我司能夠按既定時程【預付】貴方未來的商務需求。
quizzes.strategy: 商務信函確認合約與服務條款，選入 give A an advance 完全契合對外商務溝通承諾。
quizzes.examTrapTip: 注意題幹首字母與詞性提示，並結合信件主旨進行主動回憶。

📢 [EXECUTIVE POLICY ANNOUNCEMENT]
To: All Branch Directors
Subject: Long-term Development Framework

The executive board has approved comprehensive guidelines to _____ sustainable performance across all regional subsidiaries.
quizzes.stemTranslation:
📢【高層政策公告】
收件人：各分行總監
主旨：長期發展架構藍圖

執行董事會已核准全方位準則，以在所有區域子公司中【預付】可持續之營運績效。
